caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-skirted dress with a fitted bodice, long sleeves, and a small triangular collar. The dress is rendered in a light beige or cream color and features an all-over repeated geometric pattern consisting of small brown and black motifs. The dress is outlined in black and is detailed with additional lines to indicate seams and folds. To the left of the dress, there is a rectangular swatch of fabric pattern in brown, white, and black, displaying a horizontal, wavy-line geometric design with repeating shapes. To the right of the dress, there are two smaller sketches: one shows a simplified outline of the dress's top half, and the other depicts a horizontal strip with a gathered or ruffled texture. The drawing is set on a plain beige background, and the artist's signature, "BMILLER," appears near the lower right of the dress.
title: Dress
